identified_gaps: Covariance kernels host-callable but NOT operationally consumed by any live portfolio calculation — wire + flip flag honestly.
No versioned PortfolioState aggregate (§4) — build from PortfolioMetrics + reservations + exposure.
No native constrained risk-based allocator / portfolio-vol / risk-contribution compute (§3/§7/§25) — add native C++ PortfolioAllocator (complements, does not duplicate, the CVXPY MV optimizer).
No capital-reservation ledger across concurrent recommendations with pending exposure + unknown-outcome handling (§16).
No PortfolioRecommendation contract (§11) nor target-weight->quantity sizing (§10).
No replacement workflow state machine (§13) — decision logic exists, coordinator does not.
No portfolio pipeline wiring optimizer->reservation->bridge into the production path (§17).
No portfolio decision events (§18) nor portfolio dashboard fields (§19).

architecture_decision.gpu_consume: Operationally consume covariance + EWMA covariance (the heavy O(obs*assets^2) work). Correlation, portfolio volatility, risk contributions, scenario losses are cheap linear algebra on the small assets x assets matrix -> CPU/numpy (+ native C++) per measured-crossover; do NOT dispatch tiny ops to GPU.
architecture_decision.mc_reductions: Monte-carlo/reductions GPU kernels remain compiled-but-unbound; scenario/stress losses computed deterministically on CPU. GPU MC consumption is a tracked future increment (requires pybind bindings) — NOT claimed consumed.
architecture_decision.optimizer: Reuse CVXPY RegimeMarkowitzAllocator for mean-variance when reliable expected returns are available; add native C++ PortfolioAllocator for the deterministic risk-based fallback (§7) + portfolio volatility + risk contributions + constraint projection (satisfies §3/§25 native optimization without duplicating the MV optimizer).
architecture_decision.no_fabrication: Heuristic strategy scores are NOT converted to expected returns; absent returns -> risk-based/deterministic policy, explicitly labeled.
